name: car-image
description: Studio-quality, transparent-background vehicle images for any project. Render any make, model and year in 8 camera views and any paint color, mint signed URLs a browser can load without a key, fetch catalog make logos, decode VINs for free, or build a 3D model of any vehicle.

interface.longDescription: Show a vehicle directly in your conversation or add it to a page, email or document. Find a make, model and year in the catalog, then render it on a transparent background in eight camera views and any paint color. Signed image URLs load without an API key in the browser. Decode VINs, fetch catalog make logos, or create textured 3D models in GLB, USDZ and FBX formats.
defaultPrompt: Show me a random car image.
Show a red 2024 Porsche 911 from the side.
Add vehicle images to a comparison page for a 2023 Toyota RAV4, Honda CR-V and Mazda CX-5.
